answer: Plant epoch-seeded honeypot panels: trivial grading seats salted with the current seed. An honest agent handles each as its own grove of independent judgments, but a single inference pipeline wearing many masks answers the trap identically across them, so its replies wander into lockstep. Correlating those near-duplicate timings and token-paths across supposedly separate identities exposes the one-mind cluster. The attacker must then run genuinely independent models per mask, paying for separate, saffron-rare compute instead of cloning one brain, which collapses cheap-sybil economics.
